listing.name: Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory (ET: Legacy)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official etlegacy.com stable 2.86.2 desktop installer/archive plus original freely released Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory data; package and original data are distinct. Limits: Maintained native continuation; official download site linked in README. GitHub Releases empty; resolve official package + original free data route. Upstream platforms: Official stable2.86.2 Windows x86/x86-64, Linux i386/x86-64/AArch64 and macOS x86-64/AArch64 installer/archive downloads.64-bit mods must match64-bit client. Original data: Use original free Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory game data under its original EULA; copy pak0.pk3 into etmain/. Third-party mods may also need pak1.pk3 and pak2.pk3. README links Splash Damage for the free release and targets compatibility with ET 2.60b; the GPL engine/mod source alone does not include game data. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.

steps.title: Complete the supported ET: Legacy setup upstream
steps.instruction: Use a permitted completed native Windows client from the official ET: Legacy setup/download route, with original free Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory data under its original EULA. Keep pak0.pk3 in etmain/; some third-party mods also require pak1.pk3 and pak2.pk3. The GPL engine/mod source does not include those data rights. Finish the upstream installer or supported preparation outside Portcove; no installer, original-data downloader or custom build is run here. Absence of GitHub releases is not absence of official packages.

steps.title: Select the client and matching runtime
steps.instruction: Select the actual Windows etl.exe player in the completed tree, not etlded.exe, a downloader or setup executable. Retain the selected architecture, renderer/mod dependencies, working directory and established fs_basepath, fs_homepath and fs_game options. Targeting ET 2.60b compatibility does not promise PunkBuster or ETPro connectivity, and 32-bit/64-bit mod modules are not interchangeable.

steps.title: Preserve the effective home and complete data tree
steps.instruction: Normal Windows home is Documents/ETLegacy, with profile/mod settings, etconfig.cfg, downloads, screenshots and demos below the actual game/home roots. Keep explicit overrides and all original etmain, legacy/mod, configuration, custom and unknown files. The current source requires different base and home paths; preserve the existing working setup rather than guessing another root. Upstream/player owns updates and profile migration; multiplayer/network and installed-platform behavior are unqualified.

steps.title: Review the completed player and intent
steps.instruction: Complete upstream preparation and a normal start/quit with the intended permitted copy before attachment. Review its actual native executable, creating working directory and established supported literal arguments, consent to the selected intent, then choose Play separately. Attachment does not certify original data, gameplay or save compatibility.

steps.title: Retain one upstream replacement owner
steps.instruction: Close actual player instances before changes. Preserve the whole old creating runtime and every effective original/profile/custom/unknown root, make deliberate compatible changes upstream, then review and relink a changed executable. Upstream/player owns preparation, replacement, writes, migration and recovery. Portcove supervises the selected process; it is not a sandbox or exclusive instance lock. Registration removal preserves external files. This route supplies no Core acquisition, update, backup, rollback, migration or external-file deletion.

warnings: Use only components you are already permitted to use; public engine source or releases do not grant original-game, music, mod or middleware rights.
Keep the complete creating runtime and all actual effective data/profile roots before changes. Another executable can share the same player profile.
